description_en: Queries the session history of Session Manager
description_zh: 查看Session Manager会话历史记录
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-terminal-sessions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp1i7gg30r52z2em0000 --session-id s-hz023od0x90000 --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTerminalSessions

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数。

最大值为100。

默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned in this call
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值

ClientIP.description_en: The client IP address of the remote connection

ClosedReason.description_en:
The reason why the connection was closed.
This parameter is returned only when the Status is `Disconnected`, `Terminated`, or `Failed`. Valid values:
InstanceNotExists: The specified instance does not exist or has been released.
InstanceNotRunning: The instance is not running.
DeliveryTimeout: The connection timed out.
AgentNeedUpgrade: Cloud Assistant Agent needs to be upgraded.
AgentNotOnline: Cloud Assistant Agent is not connected to the server.
MessageFormatInvalid: The message format is invalid.
AgentSocketClosed: The connection was closed normally.
ClientClosed: The session management client closed the connection.
ReadFromTargetPortFailed: Failed to read data from the target port during data forwarding with the PortNumber specified in StartTerminalSession.
ReopenTargetPortFailed: Failed to re-establish a TCP connection to the target port during data forwarding with the PortNumber specified in StartTerminalSession.
OpenTargetPortFailed: Failed to establish a TCP connection to the target port during data forwarding with the PortNumber specified in StartTerminalSession.
WinptyPermissionDenied: For Windows instances, failed to grant the specified user read and execute permissions on winpty.dll or winpty-agent.exe.
PasswordNameNotFound: The PasswordName specified in StartTerminalSession was not found.
ProcessSessionDataError: Failed to process session data.
SessionIdDuplicate: The session ID is duplicate.
SessionTimeout: The session timed out. A session connection that exceeds 3 hours is proactively disconnected.
IdleTimeout: The connection timed out. A connection with no session interaction for 180 seconds is considered idle and proactively disconnected.
HomeDirPermissionDenied: Insufficient permissions on the home directory of the user to be connected.
HomeDirNotFound: The home directory of the user to be connected does not exist.
ShellCommandPermissionDenied: Insufficient permissions on the shell program. bash or csh does not have execute permissions.
ShellCommandNotFound: The shell program does not exist. The bash file on Linux, the csh file on FreeBSD, or the powershell.exe file on Windows does not exist.
ObtainUserInfoFailed: Failed to obtain the Username parameter information (home directory information).
ObtainUserIdentityFailed: Failed to obtain the Username parameter authentication information (uid, gid, groups).
UserNotExists: The Username specified in StartTerminalSession does not exist.
MalformedCommandLine: Failed to parse the CommandLine specified in StartTerminalSession
ClosedReason.description_zh:
连接结束原因。
仅在状态（`Status`）为`Disconnected`、`Terminated`、`Failed`时返回该参数。可能值：
InstanceNotExists：指定的实例不存在或已释放。
InstanceNotRunning：该实例不在运行中。
DeliveryTimeout：连接超时。
AgentNeedUpgrade：云助手 Agent 需要升级。
AgentNotOnline：云助手Agent未连接到服务器。
MessageFormatInvalid：消息格式不合法。
AgentSocketClosed：连接正常关闭。
ClientClosed：会话管理客户端关闭了连接。
ReadFromTargetPortFailed：StartTerminalSession指定PortNumber数据转发时，从目标端口读取数据时失败。
ReopenTargetPortFailed：StartTerminalSession指定PortNumber数据转发时，重新向目标端口发起TCP连接失败。
OpenTargetPortFailed：StartTerminalSession指定PortNumber数据转发时，向目标端口发起TCP连接失败。
WinptyPermissionDenied：对于Windows实例，为winpty.dll 或者 winty-agent.exe 增加指定用户的可读可执行权限失败。
PasswordNameNotFound：未找到StartTerminalSession指定的PasswordName。
ProcessSessionDataError：处理会话数据失败。
SessionIdDuplicate：会话ID重复。
SessionTimeout：会话超时（一次会话连接超过3小时会主动断开）。
IdleTimeout：连接超时（180秒没有会话交互，认为连接空闲主动断开）。
HomeDirPermissionDenied：待连接用户的home目录权限不足。
HomeDirNotFound：待连接用户的home目录不存在。
ShellCommandPermissionDenied：Shell程序权限不足（bash、csh没有可执行权限）。
ShellCommandNotFound：Shell程序不存在（Linux系统--bash、FreeBSD系统--csh、Windows系统--powershell.exe文件不存在）。
ObtainUserInfoFailed：获取Username参数信息失败（家目录信息）。
ObtainUserIdentityFailed：获取Username参数鉴权信息失败(uid、gid、groups)。
UserNotExists：StartTerminalSession时指定的Username不存在。
MalformedCommandLine：StartTerminalSession时指定的CommandLine解析失败

EndTime.description_en: The time when the connection ended. The time is displayed in ISO 8601 format in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 连接结束时间。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

FailedDetail.description_en: The details of the connection failure. This parameter is returned only when the Status is Failed
FailedDetail.description_zh: 连接失败原因详情。仅在状态（Status）为Failed时返回该参数
FailedDetail.example: The Session Manager is closed normally.

StartTime.description_en: The time when the connection started. The time is displayed in ISO 8601 format in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 连接开始时间。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

Status.description_en:
The session status. Valid values:
Connecting: The session is being connected.
Connected: The session is connected.
Terminated: The session is terminated.
Failed: The connection failed
Status.description_zh:
会话状态，可能值：
Connecting：连接中。
Connected：已连接。
Terminated：会话已终止。
Failed：连接失败

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the session was created. The time is displayed in ISO 8601 format in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 会话的创建时间。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

IdentityType.description_en:
The identity type. Valid values:
Account: Alibaba Cloud account.
RAMUser: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
AssumedRoleUser: RAM role
IdentityType.description_zh:
身份类型。当前支持的身份类型包括：
Account：阿里云账号（主账号）。
RAMUser：RAM用户。
AssumedRoleUser：RAM角色

PortNumber.description_en: The port number of the ECS instance used for data forwarding. If no port number is configured for data forwarding, this value is empty
PortNumber.description_zh: ECS实例的端口号，用于数据转发。若未设置数据转发的端口号，则该值为空

PrincipalId.description_en:
The identity ID. The value varies based on the IdentityType:
If the caller is an Alibaba Cloud account: The Alibaba Cloud account ID is returned.
If the caller is a Resource Access Management (RAM) user: The RAM user ID is returned.
If the caller invokes the API through role assumption: The actual delegate ID of the role assumption is returned
PrincipalId.description_zh:
身份标识。按照身份类型`IdentityType`，取值如下：
当前调用者是阿里云账号：返回阿里云账号ID。
当前调用者是RAM用户：返回RAM用户ID。
当前调用者是角色扮演：返回角色扮演实际委托人ID

TargetServer.description_en: The address of the target server in the VPC accessed through the instance
TargetServer.description_zh: 通过实例访问VPC内的目标服务地址

Username.description_en: The username used for the connection
